Subject: Regional partner retreat — PO request, spend cap & cost-center split

Hi Marissa —

We're finalizing the budget for the Lumen Partners regional retreat (Dec 8-9). Need a PO + spend cap approved so we can secure the venue deposit and confirm AV/catering vendors this week. Attached is the up-to-date estimate. Quick summary:

- Venue deposit (Riverview Hall) — $15,000 (due 11/24)
- AV & staging (Island AV) — $8,500
- Catering (GreenFork) — $9,250
- Travel stipends (partner reps, 12 people) — $3,000
- Swag & printing — $2,500
- Logistics/onsite staffing (Acme Logistics) — $10,500

Estimated total: $48,750

Ask:
1) Approve a PO / spend cap for $48,750 so we can issue vendor POs (we will reduce by partner contribution once Ben confirms).
2) Cost-center coding: please confirm we should use 4301-ENG-7210 as primary; if split is preferred we can propose a split.
3) Confirm whether travel stipends should be processed as vendor invoice or employee reimbursements (we expect most will be vendor stipends but some will be on personal cards).

Attachment: PartnerRetreat_Estimate_v2.xlsx

I'm cc'ing Ben and Vanessa for partner billing context and logistics. If you can get PO guidance by EOD Thursday, we can keep the vendor dates.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Regional partner retreat — PO request, spend cap & cost-center split

Thanks Soojin — quick update from the partner side: Lumen Partners has committed $10,000 toward the event (mktg sponsorship + co-host fee). That reduces Redwood's net liability to $38,750. I've attached the signed MOU.

Operational asks:
- Can Finance issue a single PO for the net amount ($38,750) and list Island AV and GreenFork as vendors under the PO? If we have to create multiple vendor POs, that's fine but we'd like a master PO or reference number for reconciliation in HubSpot (deal HS-23847).
- Travel stipends: Lumen says they prefer we route partner travel through vendor invoices (so they get a single line-item), but the partners will accept stipends paid to attendees directly if that's simpler. Recommend we cap partner travel reimbursements at $3,000 total.

Attaching: Lumen_Participation_MOU.pdf

Thanks — a few items to clarify before I route to Finance:

1) Cost-center split: recommend 60% 4301-ENG and 40% 2105-GTM given this is a partner-facing program but with heavy product presence. That would make the split (on the $38,750 net):
   - 4301-ENG: $23,250
   - 2105-GTM: $15,500

2) Travel stipends: prefer to process partner travel as vendor invoice if Island/Acme can accept and itemize the stipend amounts. If not, we will process as individual employee reimbursements (via Concur), with a clear cap and policy. Please confirm which vendors will bill the stipends.

3) Vendor docs: Finance will need W-9s for any vendor invoice > $5k, and Island AV/GreenFork need vendor onboarding started if not already in Coupa. Can someone confirm vendor contacts so I can kick off onboarding?

Once Ben confirms vendor billing approach I will prepare the split and forward to Finance for PO creation.

—Marissa
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Regional partner retreat — PO request, spend cap & cost-center split

Thanks for the details. Finance reviewed and we can issue a PO with the following conditions:

- Approved net PO amount: $38,750 (this reflects the $10,000 partner credit). PO number: PO-2026-1157.
- Cost-center split required as requested: 60% (4301-ENG) / 40% (2105-GTM). Use GL codes 7210 (events) and 5410 (travel stipends) where applicable.
- Travel stipends: capped at $3,000 total and must be processed as employee reimbursement unless the vendor can accept a line-item invoice that includes the stipend and provides W-9. If vendor invoices include stipends, vendor must submit W-9 and be onboarded before payment.
- Vendors >$25k require a secondary approver; since our net is under that for a single vendor, standard approvers suffice.
- Please attach vendor W-9s and vendor onboarding tickets to the payment request.

I've attached the signed PO (PO-2026-1157.pdf). Next steps for Soojin/Marissa:
1) Confirm which vendors will receive vendor POs vs. which items will go on employee reimbursements.
2) Upload vendor W-9s and start onboarding for Island AV and GreenFork (if not already in system).
3) Create one payment request in Coupa/Finance with the PO reference and the cost-center split.

Vendor onboarding & payment link: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4021

Markus Klein
